property_summary: For every caller address A, when admin (the contract deployer) calls setOwner(A) the reference contract will set owner == A (call succeeds only for admin), whereas the mutant inverts onlyAdmin so admin cannot set owner but non-admins can, thus there exist caller addresses for which setOwner succeeds on the mutant but fails on the reference (and vice versa); we assert that if the caller is the admin then setOwner succeeds and owner equals the provided address.
change_summary: Invert the onlyAdmin check so non-admins can call functions using onlyAdmin but the admin cannot, changing whether setOwner can succeed and thus owner.
